identity:
W20 entered the testing chamber with instructions to don the protective gear inside, and stand in front of the X-ray screen.  The X-ray technician performed the scan of W20's arms and when the film was processed, it showed nothing, exactly as it though it had hit a protective barrier.

Our subsequent proposal to use a radium sample was immediately denied by W20, who stated they would never participate in such an experiment and left the room.
